global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and crisp menma. Topped with shredded cabbage and nori, it sits in a blue-and-white patterned bowl on a wooden table, bathed in warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
regions.bowl: Blue and white ceramic bowl with intricate floral pattern and raised rim, glossy finish, ornate detailing.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and shredded white toppings.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough, uneven surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with crispy, browned edges and visible fat marbling.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale, translucent, slightly curved strips with a glossy, moist surface.
